This varies depending on your fitness level so I can't give you an actual number but you want to aim to do 8-12 reps (with good form). By the end of the 12th rep you should feel like you can't do another rep with proper form; near muscle failure.

Play around and adjust the weights to find this sweet spot - if you can do 13 reps the weight was too light and if you can't make 8 reps the weight is too heavy. I would suggest finding somebody to show you proper form when lifting weights so that you don't hurt yourself.
